newsitem.title: USA: Dominion Bridge holders approve of ruling.
newsitem.headline: Dominion Bridge holders approve of ruling.

text.p: The Committee to Revitalize Dominion Bridge Corp, a group of insurgent investors seeking to oust senior management at Dominion Bridge Corp, said Thursday that it approved the ruling of a U.S. district judge in Delaware to reject the company's plea for expedited court hearings.

Dominion Bridge had asked the court for an expedited hearing on several claims charging the Committee with misrepresentations, tortuous interference and the illegality of a proposed change in by-laws.
The Committee said that the court's decision not to speed up any litigation meant that shareholders would be able to vote on its consent solicitiation to remove senior management by July 18.

The Committee's statement came in response to a Dominion Bridge release issued earlier today, in which the company said shareholders would have been served better by an immediate court decision on the issues.
Dominion Bridge is a Canadian-based engineering and infrastructure firm with 6,500 employees worldwide.
